question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. Keep your pants on
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Keep your pants on"** means** to remain calm and patient; to wait without getting ups**et. (शांत और धैर्यवान रहें)

 
 
• **Example:** **Keep your pants on, **the doctor will see you soon.
 
 
 
• **"To keep calm and quiet"** refers to maintaining composure and not causing a disturbance. (शांत और चुप रहना)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite the chaos, he managed to keep calm and quiet.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: *** To keep calm and quiet.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To wear the dress neatly** (कपड़े को साफ सुथरा पहनना): To dress in a tidy and orderly manner.

 
 
• **Example:** She always makes sure to wear her dress neatly before going to work.
 
 
 
• **To make things proper** (चीजों को सही करना): To arrange or correct things so they are in the right order.
 
 
• **Example: **He took time to make things proper before the guests arrived.
 
 
 
• **To work like a tailor** (दर्जी की तरह काम करना): To work meticulously and with precision, similar to how a tailor would.
 
 
• **Example:** She worked like a tailor, ensuring every detail was perfect.
 
 

 

51:Tade,

The correct answer is: **Option 1)**
